description: DFlash2 draft steps of Muse Spark at TP8: rows = requests x 8 draft-block rows, launched at the compiled widths 8, 16, 32 and 64 (a step pads to the next width; 8 and 16 are the default served widths, 32 and 64 are served with SGLANG_AMD_MONO_MUSE_WIDTHS=8,16,32,64). first = true is the draft's first layer (one of its five D-pre launches a step). The weight stream (W_kp 33.6 MB + W_qkv 21.0 MB a rank) does not depend on the rows, so the >= 10 us production range spans 8x: the task uses the production-range span exemption (workload_evidence.json). Row frequencies from the AgentX per-session in-flight distribution (semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126 rev 23f152f6); derived from corpus statistics, not yet confirmed by a live capture. Monokernels serve decode / verify only; prefill shapes do not apply.

cases.source: boundary: non-power-of-two rows (three requests; production pads them to the 32-row width)
the draft's first layer (residual = x) at the 16-row width
the draft's first layer at the 64-row width
minimum: one request's 8-row draft block (C1; 26.7% of served draft steps), layers 1-4 (residual added)
one request's 8-row draft block, the draft's first layer (one of five D-pre launches a step)
two requests (C2, the second default served width; 25.6% of served draft steps)
the largest compiled width: five to eight requests (23.3% of served draft steps)
